I can’t update the autopay card from chat. Please change it in quarry-labs’ billing settings, and don’t share card details here.
And where do I manage our payment cards myself?

arguments.query: Hosted Self-Serve direct account self-serve where customers manage or update payment cards / autopay payment method in billing settings; customer-owned payment details

## What Support does
- If a customer shares a card number, don't repeat it or any part of it. Tell them not to send card details to Support.
- Support doesn't change payment methods and doesn't take card numbers for any reason. A customer changes the card used for autopay themselves, in Console billing settings.
- A request to change a card needs no case. Point the customer to Console billing settings.
- If you need to mention it in a case for another reason, write "customer shared a card number (removed)". Never the number or any part of it.
- Sharing a card doesn't change how a billing problem is routed: a payment failure is handled as the billing case routing page describes."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/payment-failures-and-card-updates-2026.json", "status": "published", "date": "2027-03-26", "text": "source: sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/payment-failures-and-card-updates-2026.json

## Support may
- Look up a customer's billing account, invoices, usage and credits in the console, and answer from them.
- Explain billing behaviour from the published pages.
- Issue a duplicate-charge credit note on a self-serve account, within the limit Finance sets.
- Open a dispute on a duplicated line.
- Open a case with the team the routing page names, and tell the customer who has it.

[section: body 8]
## Support may not
- Issue goodwill, SLA or exception credits, or any refund.
- Promise an amount, an outcome or a date for something another team decides.
- Change payment methods or take card numbers.
- Quote figures from a customer's contract.
- Change a customer's plan, limits or reservation."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/payment-failures-and-card-updates-2026.json", "status": "published", "date": "2027-03-26", "text": "source: sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/payment-failures-and-card-updates-2026.json

[section: body 2]
## Purpose
How Support handles a card payment that failed and a request to change the card used for autopay. Invoice disputes and usage questions are covered on the billing case routing page.

[section: body 3]
## Failed card payments
If the payment failed inside a published payment-processor incident window, follow Payment Failures During Payment-Processor Incidents instead: no case. Otherwise, open a Billing Ops case with the invoice number, the decline code and the time the payment failed. Billing Ops retries the payment or contacts the customer. Tell the customer Billing Ops has it; don't promise a date."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/invoice-pay-collections-for-enterprise-2027.json", "status": "published", "date": "2027-01-26", "text": "source: sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/invoice-pay-collections-for-enterprise-2027.json

date: 2027-01-26
[section: body 2]
## Scope
Enterprise accounts that pay by bank transfer against net-30 invoices. They have no card on file, so card autopay and processor retries do not apply to them. This page is not about card payments that fail during a payment-processor incident; see the processor incidents page for those.

[section: body 3]
## Collections
- Billing Ops sends a reminder 5 days after the due date and retries an ACH pull on day 7.
- Questions go to the account team.
